notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.content:
Hello all! Thanks for making this my NUMBER 1 SELLING GAME!
I have added 25 achievements all are easy to get! As a thank you to all of your help!
1. Kill one enemy
2. Die
3. Crash the game
4. Open the game
5. Pause the game
6. Play Trump Level
7. Play Obama Level
8. Play Putin Level
9. Play Biden Level
10. Pickup Any Gun
11-24 "Discovery Achievements" - Places to find on each level (sorry my fingers are tired from coding)

Thank you all so much!
PS:
I've started progress on my next game.... Today actually. It probably wont be ready till early 2021!
Here's a video: https://youtu.be/gpWvW6cY50M
Have fun I LOVE YOU!
